text: {"judgments":[{"claim_index":0,"verdict":"SUPPORTED","reason":"The Budget & Timeline Breakdown Risk Notes section states the Engineering team flagged smart TV integration testing as the highest-risk item on the timeline."},{"claim_index":1,"verdict":"PARTIAL","reason":"The Team & Governance Document does call it 'a high-risk item', but the evidence doesn't establish the 'only ... not the highest-risk' part; that it avoids calling it the highest is an inference from the quote, and nothing in the evidence rules out a stronger statement elsewhere in the document."},{"claim_index":2,"verdict":"SUPPORTED","reason":"Absence claim that only says the documents don't describe smart TV testing as a risk item in the Project Overview Document; it asserts no other fact."},{"claim_index":3,"verdict":"SUPPORTED","reason":"Absence claim that only says the Project Overview Document states no risk ranking for smart TV testing; it asserts no other fact."}]}
